description: Caller passes seconds to set_timeout, which another file defines in milliseconds; the diff alone reads as correct.

change_request.title: Raise export timeout
change_request.description: Large exports were timing out; allow 30 seconds.

lines.content: # Large exports can take up to 30 seconds.

repository_files.app/sync.py:
from app.client import Client


def make_client(host: str) -> Client:
    client = Client(host)
    # Large exports can take up to 30 seconds.
    client.set_timeout(30)
    return client

labels.note: 30 ms, not 30 s: set_timeout takes milliseconds
